description: Togo - Global Electrification Platform (GEP) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy access, Policies and plans", published or maintained by World Bank (World Bank Group). The Global Electrification Platform (GEP) is a multi-phase project led by the World Bank to standardize and simplify the use of geospatial tools for least-cost electrification planning. The GEP provides a high-level overview of the technology mix (grid and off-grid) required to achieve universal access by 2030. Coverage: Togo. It has 15 files in SHP ZIP, ZIP, CSV, XLSX, DOC. The portal files it under Energy access, Policies and plans. The portal gives 2019 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
